---
title: "Analysis of EMI at the individual level"
author: "Segun Aroyehun"
output: pdf_document
---
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)
library(Hmisc)
library(lmtest)
library(tseries)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(stargazer)
library(car)
library(sandwich)
library(clubSandwich)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggeffects)
library(margins)
library(marginaleffects)
library(boot)
library(kableExtra)
library(modelsummary)
library(visreg)
library(tinytable)

set.seed(1234)
setwd(".")


output_path <- "../output"
f <- function(x) format(x, digits = 3, nsmall = 2)
f_est <- function(x) formatC(x, format="f", digits=3)
f_p <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    x < 0.001,
    formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 3),
    formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)
  )
}


df <- read.csv("../data/memberlevel_sbertllms.csv")
df$emi <- df$rating_emb_pool_z
df$ideology <- abs(df$nominate_dim1)

df$bioguide_id <- factor(df$bioguide_id)
df$congress <- factor(df$congress)
df$republican <- ifelse(
df$party_name == "Republican Party",
  1,
  0
)

df$female <- ifelse(
df$gender == "F",
  1,
  0
)

df$senate <- ifelse(
df$chamber == "Senate",
  1,
  0
)

cor.test(df$emi, df$nominate_dim1_absfloordistance)
cor.test(df$emi, df$ideology)


vars <- c(
  "emi", "nominate_dim1_absfloordistance", "congress",
  "gender", "chamber_opposition", "bioguide_id",
  "republican", "senate", "ideology",
  grep("^prop_topic_", names(df), value = TRUE)
)

df <- df[complete.cases(df[, vars]), ]

vars_to_scale <- c(
  "emi",
  "nominate_dim1_absfloordistance",
  "ideology",
  grep("^prop_topic_", names(df), value = TRUE)
)

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(vars_to_scale),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))
    )
  )

emi_model_base <- lmer(emi ~ 1 + ideology + congress 
                + republican 
                + senate
                + (1|bioguide_id),
                data = df )
summary(emi_model_base)
vif(emi_model_base)

emi_model <- lmer(emi ~ 1 + ideology + congress 
                + chamber_opposition + president_opposition +  republican 
                + female + senate
                + prop_topic_Agriculture + prop_topic_Civil.Rights
                + prop_topic_Defense + prop_topic_Domestic.Commerce
                + prop_topic_Education + prop_topic_Energy
                + prop_topic_Environment + prop_topic_Foreign.Trade
                + prop_topic_Government.Operations + prop_topic_Health
                + prop_topic_Housing + prop_topic_Immigration
                + prop_topic_International.Affairs + prop_topic_Labor
                + prop_topic_Law.and.Crime + prop_topic_Macroeconomics
                + prop_topic_Public.Lands + prop_topic_Social.Welfare
                + prop_topic_Technology + prop_topic_Transportation
                + (1|bioguide_id),
                data = df )
summary(emi_model)
vif(emi_model)

vars_morecontrols <- c(
  "emi", "nominate_dim1_absfloordistance", "congress", "ideology",
  "gender", "chamber_opposition", "bioguide_id", "republican", "senate",
  "seniority_terms", "first_term",
  "committee_chair", "subcommittee_chair",
  "majority_party_leadership", "minority_party_leadership",
  "vote_share_lastelection", "served_instateleg", "log_les",
  grep("^prop_topic_", names(df), value = TRUE)
)

df_morecontrols1973 <- df[complete.cases(df[, vars_morecontrols]), ]
# "log_speechcount", "log_tokencount",
vars_to_scale <- c(
  "emi",
  "nominate_dim1_absfloordistance",
  "ideology",
  "seniority_terms",
  "vote_share_lastelection",
  "log_les",
  grep("^prop_topic_", names(df), value = TRUE)
)

df_morecontrols1973 <- df_morecontrols1973 |>
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(vars_to_scale),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))
    )
  )

emi_model_morecontrols1973 <- lmer(emi ~ 1 + ideology + congress 
                + chamber_opposition + president_opposition + republican 
                + female + senate
                + seniority_terms + first_term 
                + committee_chair + subcommittee_chair
                + majority_party_leadership + minority_party_leadership
                + vote_share_lastelection + served_instateleg
                + prop_topic_Agriculture + prop_topic_Civil.Rights
                + prop_topic_Defense + prop_topic_Domestic.Commerce
                + prop_topic_Education + prop_topic_Energy
                + prop_topic_Environment + prop_topic_Foreign.Trade
                + prop_topic_Government.Operations + prop_topic_Health
                + prop_topic_Housing + prop_topic_Immigration
                + prop_topic_International.Affairs + prop_topic_Labor
                + prop_topic_Law.and.Crime + prop_topic_Macroeconomics
                + prop_topic_Public.Lands + prop_topic_Social.Welfare
                + prop_topic_Technology + prop_topic_Transportation
                + (1|bioguide_id),
                data = df_morecontrols1973)

summary(emi_model_morecontrols1973)
vif(emi_model_morecontrols1973)

# coef plot

vcov_full <- vcovCR(
  emi_model_morecontrols1973,
  cluster = df_morecontrols1973$bioguide_id,
  type = "CR2"
)

focal_terms <- c(
  "ideology",
  "vote_share_lastelection",
  "chamber_opposition",
  "female"
)

plot_df <- modelplot(
  list("Full model" = emi_model_morecontrols1973),
  vcov = list(vcov_full),
  conf_level = 0.95,
  draw = FALSE
) |>
  filter(term %in% focal_terms) |>
  mutate(
    label = dplyr::recode(
      term,
      ideology = "Ideological extremity",
      vote_share_lastelection = "Vote share",
      chamber_opposition = "Opposition",
      female = "Female"
    ),
    label = factor(
      label,
      levels = c(
        "Female",
        "Opposition",
        "Vote share",
        "Ideological extremity"
      )
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = estimate,
    y = label,
    xmin = conf.low,
    xmax = conf.high
  )
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Coefficient estimate",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  
ggsave(
  filename = "../output/EMI_characteristics-coeff_plot.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = "../output/EMI_characteristics-coeff_plot.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 4.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

modelsummary(
  list(emi_model_base, emi_model, emi_model_morecontrols1973),
  vcov =list(vcovCR(emi_model_base, cluster = df$bioguide_id, type = "CR2"),
             vcovCR(emi_model, cluster = df$bioguide_id, type = "CR2"),
             vcovCR(emi_model_morecontrols1973, cluster = df_morecontrols1973$bioguide_id, type = "CR2")
             ),
  coef_omit = "^bioguide_id|^congress",
  gof_omit="AIC|BIC|RMSE|Log.Lik.",
  output ="../output/EMI-xteristics-meff_summary.html",
  fmt = NULL,
  estimate  = "{f_est(estimate)} [{f_est(conf.low)}, {f_est(conf.high)}]",
  statistic = "p={f_p(p.value)}", conf_level=0.95,
  notes = "Values in square brackets represent 95% confidence intervals based on CR2 cluster-robust standard errors, with clustering at the legislator level."
)


tex <- modelsummary(
  list(emi_model_base, emi_model, emi_model_morecontrols1973),
  vcov =list(vcovCR(emi_model_base, cluster = df$bioguide_id, type = "CR2"),
             vcovCR(emi_model, cluster = df$bioguide_id, type = "CR2"),
             vcovCR(emi_model_morecontrols1973, cluster = df_morecontrols1973$bioguide_id, type = "CR2")
             ),
  coef_omit = "^bioguide_id|^congress",
  gof_omit="AIC|BIC|RMSE|Log.Lik.",
  output = "tinytable",
  fmt = NULL,
  estimate = "{f_est(estimate)}",
  statistic = c(
    "[{f_est(conf.low)}, {f_est(conf.high)}]",
    "p={f_p(p.value)}"
  ),
  conf_level=0.95,
  notes = "Values in square brackets represent 95% confidence intervals based on cluster-robust standard errors, with clustering at the legislator level."
)|>
  theme_tt("tabular")
  save_tt(tex, "../output/EMI-xteristics-meff_summary.tex", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
les_model_base <- lmer(log_les ~ 1 + ideology + congress 
                + chamber_opposition + president_opposition + republican 
                + female + senate

                + african_american
                + seniority_terms + first_term

                + vote_share_lastelection + served_instateleg
                + (1|bioguide_id),
                data = df_morecontrols1973)

vif(les_model_base)

                + chamber_opposition + president_opposition + republican 
                + female + senate
                + latino_a
```

# Twitter-Congress model
```{r}
df_tw_congress <- read.csv("../data/twitter_speech_sbert_llms.csv")
df_tw_congress <- subset(
  df_tw_congress,
  party_name %in% c("Democratic Party", "Republican Party")
)
df_tw_congress$emi <- df_tw_congress$emi_mean
df_tw_congress$emi_sc <- scale(df_tw_congress$emi)
df_tw_congress$bioguide_id <- factor(df_tw_congress$bioguide_id)
df_tw_congress$year_quarter <- factor(df_tw_congress$year_quarter)


df_tw_congress$republican <- ifelse(
df_tw_congress$party_name == "Republican Party",
  1,
  0
)

df_tw_congress$senate <- ifelse(
df_tw_congress$chamber == "S",
  1,
  0
)

tw <- subset(df_tw_congress, channel == "Twitter")
floor <- subset(df_tw_congress, channel == "Floor")
merged <- merge(
  tw,
  floor,
  by = c("bioguide_id", "year_quarter", "chamber"),
  suffixes = c("_tw", "_floor")
)

cor.test(
  merged$emi_mean_tw,
  merged$emi_mean_floor
)

merged$emi_mean_tw <- scale(merged$emi_mean_tw)
merged$emi_mean_floor <- scale(merged$emi_mean_floor)

# Twitter as predictor for floor
model_floor_tw_base <- lmer(
  emi_mean_floor ~ emi_mean_tw + year_quarter +
    (1 | bioguide_id),
  data = merged
)
summary(model_floor_tw_base)

model_floor_tw <- lmer(emi_mean_floor ~ 1 + emi_mean_tw + legislative_opposition_tw
                      + presidential_opposition_tw
                      + year_quarter + senate_tw 
                      + republican_tw + (1|bioguide_id), 
                        data=merged
                        )
summary(model_floor_tw)
vif(model_floor_tw)

# floor as predictor for twitter
model_tw_floor_base <- lmer(
  emi_mean_tw ~ emi_mean_floor + year_quarter +
    (1 | bioguide_id),
  data = merged
)
summary(model_tw_floor_base)

model_tw_floor <- lmer(emi_mean_tw ~ 1 + emi_mean_floor + legislative_opposition_tw
                      + presidential_opposition_tw
                      + year_quarter + senate_tw 
                      + republican_tw + (1|bioguide_id), 
                        data=merged
                        )
summary(model_tw_floor)
vif(model_tw_floor)

# medium model
model_medium_base <- lmer(emi_sc ~ 1 + channel + year_quarter + (1|bioguide_id), 
                        data=df_tw_congress
                        )
summary(model_medium_base)


model_medium <- lmer(emi_sc ~ 1 + channel + legislative_opposition
                      + presidential_opposition
                      + year_quarter + senate
                      + republican + (1|bioguide_id), 
                        data=df_tw_congress
                        )
summary(model_medium)
vif(model_medium)

# twitter predicts floor
modelsummary(
  list(model_floor_tw_base, model_floor_tw),
  vcov =list(vcovCR(model_floor_tw_base, cluster = merged$bioguide_id, type = "CR2"),
             vcovCR(model_floor_tw, cluster = merged$bioguide_id, type = "CR2")
             ),
  coef_omit = "^bioguide_id|^year_quarter",
  gof_omit="AIC|BIC|RMSE|Log.Lik.",
  output ="../output/Twitter-Congress-meff_summary.html",
  fmt = NULL,
  estimate  = "{f_est(estimate)} [{f_est(conf.low)}, {f_est(conf.high)}]",
  statistic = "p={f_p(p.value)}", conf_level=0.95,
  notes = "Values in square brackets represent 95% confidence intervals based on cluster-robust standard errors, with clustering at the legislator level."
)

tex <- modelsummary(
  list(model_floor_tw_base, model_floor_tw),
  vcov =list(vcovCR(model_floor_tw_base, cluster = merged$bioguide_id, type = "CR2"),
             vcovCR(model_floor_tw, cluster = merged$bioguide_id, type = "CR2")
             ),
  coef_omit = "^bioguide_id|^year_quarter",
  gof_omit="AIC|BIC|RMSE|Log.Lik.",
  output ="tinytable",
  fmt = NULL,
  estimate = "{f_est(estimate)}",
  statistic = c(
    "[{f_est(conf.low)}, {f_est(conf.high)}]",
    "p={f_p(p.value)}"
  ),
  #estimate  = "{f_est(estimate)} [{f_est(conf.low)}, {f_est(conf.high)}]",
  #statistic = "p={f_p(p.value)}",
  conf_level=0.95,
  notes = "Values in square brackets represent 95% confidence intervals based on cluster-robust standard errors, with clustering at the legislator level."
)|>theme_tt("tabular")
  save_tt(tex, "../output/Twitter-Congress-meff_summary.tex", overwrite = TRUE)

# floor predicts twitter
modelsummary(
  list(model_tw_floor_base, model_tw_floor),
  vcov =list(vcovCR(model_tw_floor_base, cluster = merged$bioguide_id, type = "CR2"),
             vcovCR(model_tw_floor, cluster = merged$bioguide_id, type = "CR2")
             ),
  coef_omit = "^bioguide_id|^year_quarter",
  gof_omit="AIC|BIC|RMSE|Log.Lik.",
  output ="../output/floor-predictor-meff_summary.html",
  fmt = NULL,
  estimate  = "{f_est(estimate)} [{f_est(conf.low)}, {f_est(conf.high)}]",
  statistic = "p={f_p(p.value)}", conf_level=0.95,
  notes = "Values in square brackets represent 95% confidence intervals based on cluster-robust standard errors, with clustering at the legislator level."
)

tex <- modelsummary(
  list(model_tw_floor_base, model_tw_floor),
  vcov =list(vcovCR(model_tw_floor_base, cluster = merged$bioguide_id, type = "CR2"),
             vcovCR(model_tw_floor, cluster = merged$bioguide_id, type = "CR2")
             ),
  coef_omit = "^bioguide_id|^year_quarter",
  gof_omit="AIC|BIC|RMSE|Log.Lik.",
  output ="tinytable",
  fmt = NULL,
  estimate = "{f_est(estimate)}",
  statistic = c(
    "[{f_est(conf.low)}, {f_est(conf.high)}]",
    "p={f_p(p.value)}"
  ),
  conf_level=0.95,
  notes = "Values in square brackets represent 95% confidence intervals based on cluster-robust standard errors, with clustering at the legislator level."
)|>theme_tt("tabular")
  save_tt(tex, "../output/floor-predictor-meff_summary.tex", overwrite = TRUE)
  
# medium model
modelsummary(
  list(model_medium_base, model_medium),
  vcov =list(vcovCR(model_medium_base, cluster = df_tw_congress$bioguide_id, type = "CR2"),
             vcovCR(model_medium, cluster = df_tw_congress$bioguide_id, type = "CR2")
             ),
  coef_omit = "^bioguide_id|^year_quarter",

             vcovCR(model_medium, cluster = df_tw_congress$bioguide_id, type = "CR2")
             ),
  coef_omit = "^bioguide_id|^year_quarter",
  gof_omit="AIC|BIC|RMSE|Log.Lik.",
  output ="tinytable",
```
